title: Poisoning LLM-Induced Rule Repositories via Indirect Prompt Injection

contributions.purpose: 证明 LLM 日志解析的 induction 阶段存在投毒攻击面
contributions.mechanism: 间接 prompt injection payload 注入 induction 样例
contributions.evaluation: 3 个 Loghub 数据集 × 4 个投毒预算,解析准确率最高降 15.1pp(7/10 样例被毒)
contributions.source_quote: We present the first study of induction-stage poisoning attacks in LLM-based log parsing...

contributions.purpose: 确定最有效的 payload 格式
contributions.mechanism: 三种 payload 格式对比(instruction-style HTML comment / JSON / delimiter)
contributions.evaluation: instruction-style 显著更强,降幅随预算单调
contributions.source_quote: We systematically evaluate three payload formats...

contributions.evaluation: 总检出率 42.6%,Linux 61.1% 恢复,BGL 全漏检
contributions.source_quote: We propose a canary-based admission control defense and analyze its failure modes...

self_declared_provenance.quote: Our work extends the indirect prompt injection paradigm to a novel setting: poisoning the induction stage of rule-based log parsing systems
